pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with sharp pixel gradients at the edges. Geometry varies from wide sub-hexagonal forms on the torso to smaller, more fragmented and densely packed rectangular clusters on the lower flank and leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-tan pathways. Intersection nodes are predominantly tri-radial and quadri-radial. Corridor thickness is consistent across the mid-section but exhibits significant thinning at the limb transition points.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck displays a short, uniform, dark-textured silhouette with a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated edge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small avian subjects perched along the dorsal ridge and neck region.
